entry.name: Serperior-E5
entry.flavor: It generates energy from sunlight, then amplifies that energy dozens of times within its long body.
entry.flavorEs: Detiene los movimientos del rival con una sola mirada. Expande la energía solar dentro de su cuerpo.

abilities.textEn: At 1/3 or less of its max HP, this Pokemon's offensive stat is 1.5x with Grass attacks.
abilities.textEs: Potencia sus movimientos de tipo Planta cuando le quedan pocos PS.
abilities.detail: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Grass-type attack.
abilities.detailEs: Cuando a este Pokémon le queda 1/3 o menos de sus PS, sus movimientos de tipo Planta infligen 1.5× de daño normal.
abilities.detailZh: 当该宝可梦剩余HP为1/3或以下时，其草属性招式造成1.5×的常规伤害。
abilities.detailPt: Quando este Pokémon tem 1/3 ou menos do seu HP restante, seus movimentos do tipo Planta infligem 1.5× o dano normal.

abilities.textEn: If this Pokemon has a stat stage raised it is lowered instead, and vice versa.
abilities.textEs: Invierte los cambios en las características: bajan cuando les toca subir y suben cuando les toca bajar.
abilities.detail: If this Pokemon has a stat stage raised it is lowered instead, and vice versa.
abilities.detailEs: Cuando las estadísticas de este Pokémon fueran a subir, en su lugar bajan en la misma cantidad, y viceversa.
abilities.detailZh: 每当该宝可梦的能力要被提高时，会改为降低相同的级数，反之亦然。
abilities.detailPt: Sempre que os atributos deste Pokémon seriam aumentados, eles são em vez disso reduzidos na mesma quantidade, e vice-versa.
